residual_risks: Rendergraph custom pass registration is deferred. Requires: pass resource declaration types, insertion point validation, synchronization validation, integration tests, and documented examples before it can ship.
RenderGraphContext.renderer exposes &mut VkRenderCore under advanced-interop. While documented as unsafe/unstable, users who enable the feature gate can access raw backend state.
05-hooks.md kept as a compatibility redirect file. External links to the old doc will land on a page that directs readers to the canonical 05-render-hooks-and-extension-points.md.

cross_field_consistency.notes: All phase statuses, command results, and report paths consistent. Phase 03 deferral is an accepted architectural decision, not a validation failure. No spurious fully_validated claim.
